data.text: HERE you will find an assorted mix of experiments, some failed and some discarded, concepts loved or forgotten, branched versions of new or old work, thoughts and musings, typographic alchemy and more. We like to show these visual expressions as even something unseen or unused may hold inside it some sort of shy value. We’ll continue to add to this collection over time as we explore further.
